page.title: Brünnelistock, Rossälplispitz and Zindlenspitz (2097 m) -- Hike Plan

hero.subtitle_html: Wägitalersee, P. 932 -> Brünnelistock, Rossälplispitz and Zindlenspitz -- SAC T5 | ~1432 m gain | ~11.3 km | ~4h30

intro_html: A spectacular three-summit ridge traverse between the Wägital and Glarus. Starting from Wägitalersee, the route links Brünnelistock (2132 m), Rossälplispitz (2075 m) and Zindlenspitz (2097 m) — one of the great classics of the region. The crux is the exposed ridge to Brünnelistock (T5−); the rest ranges from T3 to T4 with fixed ropes and chains.

bullets_html: P. 931 via Hohfläsch-Hütte (1368 m) to Hohfläschenmatt (1687 m) — 2 h 15 min
Hohfläschenmatt to saddle P. 1989 — narrow, slightly exposed ledges without scrambling
Detour to Brünnelistock (2132 m) — exposed ridge, no belaying possibilities (T5−, crux)
Saddle P. 1989 to Rossälplispitz (2075 m) — fixed ropes on rocky summit slope (T3+)
Rossälplispitz to Zindlenspitz (2097 m) via P. 1979 — steep rocky outcrop with chain (T4−), easy scrambling before summit

getting_there.by_pt_html: Bus to Innerthal, Gemeindeplatz, then ~45 min on foot along the road to P. 932. Alternatives: rent a bike at Gasthaus Stausee (055 446 12 79), boat taxi via waegitalersee.ch (055 446 13 44), Alpentaxi, or Mobility from Siebnen-Wangen station.
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Wägitalersee east shore. A few parking spaces at the Fläschloch cable car valley station, ~500 m past P. 932.

safety_html: Exposure: The ridge from P. 1989 to Brünnelistock has exposed passages without belaying possibilities (T5−). Not suitable for those uncomfortable with exposure.
Wet conditions: SAC explicitly warns against undertaking this tour in wet conditions — exposed rock and ledges become very dangerous.
Fixed ropes/chains: Fixed ropes on Rossälplispitz and a chain after P. 1901 — check condition before relying on them.
Turn back if thunderstorms develop — lightning risk on the exposed ridge is extreme.
